gold.title: When requests are authenticated with API keys or org auth tokens (which have user_id=None), organization_context.member
gold.description: When requests are authenticated with API keys or org auth tokens (which have user_id=None), organization_context.member is None. Line 71 attempts to access organization_context.member.has_global_access without checking if member is None, causing an AttributeError crash when optimized_pagination=true is used, even though the request passed all permission checks with valid org:write scope.

candidate.title: `enable_advanced` gate grants unintended pagination to every caller
candidate.description: `has_global_access` means 'sees all teams' (true for every member), not 'is admin'. Superuser check bypasses elevated session requirement. Unguarded `.has_global_access` access on potentially-None `organization_context.member` causes AttributeError for non-member tokens.

gold.description: get_item_key assumes a numeric key, but the paginator is used with order_by=-datetime in the audit logs endpoint; calling math.floor/ceil on a datetime will raise a TypeError.

candidate.title: `OptimizedCursorPaginator` uses integer key semantics on datetime column
candidate.description: `math.ceil(<datetime>)` raises TypeError. `value_from_cursor` returns int instead of datetime, emitting `WHERE datetime <= <int>` comparison. Endpoint 500s on any audit row. Should subclass `DateTimePaginator` instead.

gold.description: Django querysets do not support negative slicing

candidate.title: Negative-offset slicing raises ValueError; comment claims opposite
candidate.description: Django's QuerySet raises ValueError on negative slice bounds, but comment falsely claims 'Django properly handles negative slicing automatically'. Feature is entirely non-functional.

promotion_candidates.title: `OptimizedCursorPaginator.get_result` duplicates base with misaligned comments
promotion_candidates.description: Lines 845–911 verbatim copy of BasePaginator.get_result; future base fixes are silently missed. Comment at 179–181 says 'allow negative offsets' directly above code that rejects them. Narrative comments restate code without adding information.
